newsitem.title: INDIA: India sugar suffers setback at improved level.
newsitem.headline: India sugar suffers setback at improved level.

text.p: Sugar prices suffered a setback at the improved level on the local market on Thursday, dealers said.
Consumer demand and enquiries from retailers was sluggish while fresh arrivals prompted profit-taking.
In ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by 10 rupees at 1,470/1,500 rupees per quintal while sugar M-30 fell by 5/15 rupees at 1,495/1,535 rupees per quintal.
"Weak trend in the mill delivery also subdued the sentiments in the ready delivery," one broker said.
Arrivals of sugar from mills to the market improved today as the law-and-order situation in the city returned to normal after the recent riots.
"Now transport operators have started plying their trucks from the mills to market," a broker added.
Sugar mill delivery fell on higher offerings by local millers due to sluggish outstation demand.
In mill delivery sugar S-30 slid by 5 rupees at 1,405/1,415 rupees per quintal and sugar M-30 slid by 5/10 rupees at 1,420/1,440 rupees per quintal.
Overall market sentiment was subdued at the close of the session.
